videos.title: AWS Sagemaker AI Crash Course-Customize and Deploy Any LLM
videos.description:
This video provides a complete end-to-end tutorial on fine-tuning, aligning, and deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) serverlessly using Amazon SageMaker AI. Here we demonstrates four levels of LLM customization—Prompt Engineering, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with LoRA, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and Reinforcement Learning (RLVR & RLAIF). Using real-world hands-on demonstrations, a base model is customized on legal contracts (Contract NLI dataset), evaluated against expert benchmarks, and served via an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint. Finally, the video covers model alignment using DPO, advanced reinforcement learning notebooks, and low-code customization workflows using an AI agent (Kiru CLI) and the SageMaker Studio UI.

Workshop Link: fandf.co/4gOfvHD

Code github: https://github.com/sourangshupal/sagemaker-model-customization-demo
